pairs.question: Cum successor Moysi destinaretur Auses filius Nave, transfertur certe de pristino nomine et incipit vocari Iesus?
pairs.derivation: Tertullian, debating the personified opponent (the Marcionite/Jew, 'cum partiariis erroris tui Iudaeis'), poses a factual yes/no question about whether Hoshea (Auses) son of Nun was renamed Jesus on becoming Moses' successor. The interlocutor concedes 'Certe' ('Certainly'). I dropped the framing tag 'inquis' from the answer (it narrates the speaking, per the prompt). The answer ends at the concession; what follows ('Hanc prius dicimus figuram futuri fuisse...') is Tertullian resuming his own exposition, not part of the reply. The preceding deflection 'Quomodo, inquis? Disce et hic...' is excluded as a non-answering preamble that precedes the actual question.
